supabaseConnectionExhaustion.description: [Supabase] Hold N idle Postgres connections to exhaust the connection limit. When a Management token is configured the load generator auto-raises the pooler pool_size above max_connections so real backends exhaust (and reverts on off). Combine with supabaseServiceErrors to cascade backend faults into auth/storage 5xx.

supabaseAccountingBackend.description: [Supabase] Select how the accounting service writes orders to Supabase: 'npgsql' (direct session-pooler connection, full auto-instrumented SQL spans via Npgsql driver) or 'supabase_sdk' (C# Supabase SDK via PostgREST, manual spans only — same OTel gap as the payment-charge edge function). Only takes effect when ACCOUNTING_DB_CONNECTION_STRING is set. Flip at runtime to compare automatic db.query.text spans against the PostgREST blind spot. See supa-accounting-backend.md.

supabaseOrderQueueBackend.description: [Supabase] Select the backend for the order post-processing flow (checkout -> accounting + fraud-detection): 'kafka' (out-of-the-box default) or 'pgmq' (Supabase Queues). Only takes effect when checkout is configured with a pgmq connection; otherwise the order flow always runs over Kafka. Flip at runtime to compare a fully auto-instrumented broker against a Postgres-native queue. See supa-pgmq-kafka.md.

supabasePaymentError.description: [Supabase] Make the payment-charge edge function fail checkout (opt-in; requires PAYMENT_EDGE_FN_URL). 'invalid_token' = blunt synthetic failure; 'card_format' = realistic regression where a too-strict card parser rejects validly-formatted (dashed) card numbers. Either produces a failed checkout, a Sentry issue, and the edge-function health check, all sharing one trace_id.

supabaseServiceErrors.description: [Supabase] Drive error volume against a Supabase service to trigger its log_*_error_rate_high health check. edge_function hammers the payment-charge function (5xx directly); auth/storage only 5xx when the DB is also exhausted (see supabaseConnectionExhaustion).
